The celebrations

Our Story, Day by Day

Five days of love, ritual and joy — we'd be honoured to have you for each.

Day One
10 December 2026 · Evening

The Engagement

The Rose Hall · 7:00 PM onwards

Where two families become one. Join us for the ring ceremony as Aarav & Ananya say their first official "yes" under a canopy of flowers.

Day Two
11 December 2026 · Morning

The Haldi

Garden Courtyard · 11:00 AM

A morning drenched in marigold and laughter. Wear your brightest yellows as we bless the couple with turmeric, music and a little playful mess.

Day Two
11 December 2026 · Night

The Pool Party

Poolside Deck · 8:00 PM

Good vibes only. Neon lights, floating florals and a night of dancing by the water before the big day arrives.

Day Three
12 December 2026 · Sunset

The Wedding

The Grand Mandap · 5:00 PM

The sacred vows. As the sun sets, we take our seven steps around the holy fire — the moment everything has been leading to.

Day Three
12 December 2026 · Night

The Reception

The Palace Ballroom · 8:30 PM

Let's celebrate. A feast under the stars, endless toasts and the first dance as we begin our forever — with all of you beside us.
